items.title: Solana enters US banking with 90 North Dakota banks leading it
items.whyYouShouldCare: The integration of Solana with North Dakota banks enhances its legitimacy and could drive increased liquidity and user adoption within the ecosystem.

items.title: PropAMMs lower Solana trade costs, and public pool returns crash
items.whyYouShouldCare: The introduction of PropAMMs reduces trading costs on Solana, but the decline in public pool returns may impact liquidity incentives and user engagement.

items.title: Open USD Is Live on Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: The launch of Open USD on Solana expands the ecosystem's stablecoin offerings, potentially increasing transaction volume and attracting new users.
